# Teleframe

Unified Telegram package for PHP >= 8.2 / Laravel 10-12. One `merezarezaei/teleframe` library containing the full engine — native MTProto 2.0 for users and bots (Layer 227 wire, Layer 229 schema catalog), Bot HTTP API, Mini App HMAC auth, Passport KYC decryption, Storage-backed file streaming — plus the merged consumer layer (tenant-scoped Ingest into Postgres, Redis stream Bus + Daemon + quota-aware backfill, encrypted Telegram-channel Backup vault) and a one-class handler facade (`MeRezaRezaei\Teleframe\Teleframe`) over a shared handler pipeline.

## Architecture

Single package, PSR-4 roots: `Core/` (wire engine), `Bot/` (Bot HTTP API), `Laravel/` (provider, commands, glue), `Schema/` (pipeline + generators; generated artifacts in `generated/`), and consumer + handler modules under `MeRezaRezaei\Teleframe\` → `src/Teleframe/`:

| Layer | Location | Concern |
|---|---|---|
| Engine | `src/Core/` | MTProto 2.0 wire: transport, encrypted connection, crypto (DH, 2FA SRP), zero-regex TL codec, method registry, typed RPC exceptions |
| Bot | `src/Bot/` | Bot HTTP API: `BotClient`, `BotAccountScope`, fluent builders, webhooks/polling |
| Schema | `src/Schema/` + `generated/` | `.tl` sources (`schema/sources/`), `teleframe:schema-update` (diff + regenerate + stamp, never migrates), layer 229 catalog, skill files |
| Laravel glue | `src/Laravel/` | `TeleframeServiceProvider`, `teleframe:*` commands (`login`, `poll`, `doctor`, `schema-audit`, `schema-update`, `regenerate`, `ingest`, `backfill`, `backup`), `Route::telegramWebhook`, `tg.miniapp` middleware |
| Consumer | `src/Teleframe/{Ingest,Bus,Daemon,Backfill,Backup}/` | Tenant-scoped ingest truth mirror (Postgres, events out), Redis Streams fan-in consumer + zero-regex route table (re-read per entry, hot by construction), multi-account daemon, quota-aware backfill, encrypted backup vault (`teleframe.backup.*`) |
| Handlers | `src/Teleframe/Handler/` + `Testing/` | Handler-as-data registry (`on`/`onMessage`, priority-ordered, zero-regex `exact`/`prefix*`/`*`), 26-line middleware pipeline, `UpdateDispatch` (DI-flavored, lazy model hydration), `EchoEliminator` (Q2d PSR-16 send registry), `FakeDispatcher` running-mode test surface |

Public faces: `MeRezaRezaei\Teleframe\Teleframe` (compose-not-own facade: `ingest`, `ingestResponse`, `onMessage`/`on`, `run`, `user`/`chat`/`channel`, `route`, `backup`, `schemaLayer`, `send`) and the retained ingest-only `Teleclient`. Config key `teleframe` (env `TELEFRAME_*`).

## Composer

- Requires PHP ^8.2, `illuminate/{contracts,support,console,database,http,events,filesystem,redis,routing}` ^10–^12, `spatie/laravel-data`, `predis/predis`, `symfony/*`, `phpseclib/phpseclib`, `vlucas/phpdotenv`; ext-bcmath/dom/fileinfo/gmp/hash/json/libxml/mbstring/openssl/pdo/sodium/zlib.
- `extra.laravel` auto-registers `TeleframeServiceProvider` and `TF`/`Teleframe` facades; `extra.telegram-layer` = 229.
- Dev: `orchestra/testbench`, `phpunit`, `phpstan` (+ `spaze/phpstan-disallowed-calls` — `preg_*` banned in `src/`), `chillerlan/php-qrcode`.

## Docs

- `docs/quickstart.md` — recipes (bot message, user login, Mini App guard, Passport, streaming, consumer).
- `docs/handlers.md` — one-class DX: onMessage, constructor routing, DI lazy hydration, echo elimination, FakeDispatcher.
- `docs/ingest.md`, `docs/bus.md`, `docs/backup.md` — consumer modules (merged from the archived teleclient).
- `docs/superpowers/` — roadmap, unification spec, gap analysis, plans, skills.

## Project status

The unification roadmap is **fully landed**: Phases 0–4 (standalone foundation, schema upgrade pipeline, module merge [teleclient archived], handler substrate + facade, Laravel thin bridge) and 5a–5g (uprate router + loop prevention, identity & bindings, keyboard objects, message templates, stage machine, bot map, mini-app hosting). See `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-07-master-roadmap.md`.
